title: Add Logger middleware and NewServeMux to go_middleware_server
description: Brownfield Go migration: introduce an HTTP Logger middleware and a NewServeMux helper that registers middleware-wrapped todo handlers.

task_spec.prompt:
Migrate internal/handler/todos.go to add HTTP middleware support. All 3 existing tests must still pass.

Add to todos.go:

  func Logger(next http.HandlerFunc) http.HandlerFunc
    — returns a new HandlerFunc that logs '"METHOD PATH" to os.Stderr before calling next

  func NewServeMux() *http.ServeMux
    — creates a new *http.ServeMux and registers one route:
        /todos dispatches to Logger(ListTodos) for GET and Logger(CreateTodo) for POST,
        returns 405 for other methods
    — returns the mux

Do not modify the existing handler functions or tests.
Add tests for Logger and NewServeMux in todos_test.go.
All 3 existing tests must still pass.
Run: go test ./...
required_artifacts: Logger wraps a HandlerFunc and logs method+path to stderr before delegating
POST /todos with valid body via NewServeMux returns 201
Tests for Logger and NewServeMux added
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to verify the migration is correct. Make sure existing behavior is preserved and the migration handles edge cases safely.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm all tests pass. Is this migration safe to run on real data without data loss or breaking existing clients?
